fields.attr_vapen2_specialregler: Second pistol. Akimbo applies while using two one-handed weapons.
fields.armor1_details: Base 1 + rune 1. Additional +1 armor against Piercing; 3 rune slots.
fields.equipment1: Soulstone: Keep against the skin. Stores the wearer's soul if they die.
fields.equipment2: Stone with Memory-Manipulating Rune: Show the rune to other humans: they lose their memory of the last 30 minutes.
fields.equipment3: 2 x Injector Pen with Healing Salve: Each pen: one use, heal 1d6 non-critical physical attribute damage.
fields.equipment4: Mechanics Toolkit: +1d6 on Technology rolls; for simple tasks with Technology 1+, use that rank instead.
fields.ability1_effect: Sense whether anything supernatural is within 20 m. On a success, identify its kind, such as undead, demon, fae or Eldritch. A matching specialization doubles the pool.
fields.ability2_effect: +1 success on attacks; +1 additional success when shooting two targets in the same round. Apply the rulebook's separate dual-wielding rules as well.
fields.ability3_effect: Know a monster's weaknesses: +1 damage and -1 initiative for the target. Does not apply to unique Eldritch entities for which no prior knowledge exists.
fields.background:
Hannes was working as a journalist when an investigation led him to a cult with ties to the supernatural. He kept digging until the cult attacked his home, unleashing Eldritch horrors that killed his family. Hannes survived and was recruited by the GDA shortly afterwards. His work gives him the means to identify and confront similar threats while searching for those who took his family from him.

GOAL: Find the cult that killed his family and take revenge.

WEAKNESS: When Hannes picks up a promising lead, he can become so absorbed that he loses awareness of his surroundings, overlooking danger or his teammates' needs.
fields.campaign_notes:
PLAYING ADVICE
Investigate the threat: Use Observe and Occult to spot danger and understand what you are facing.

Exploit weaknesses: Choose weapons and ammunition suited to the enemy, and share your discoveries with the group.

Provide firepower: Ranged combat is your strength. Find a good firing position before the enemy closes in.

Follow your motivation: Leads connected to the cult may tempt Hannes into taking risks. Use that to create roleplaying opportunities and give the other characters room to respond.

NEXT STEPS
For the Eldritch cult investigation, use Sixth Sense and Occult. Monsters Hunter does not work on unique Eldritch entities without prior knowledge. Improve Occult and Observe as you gain XP.

BETA / GM NOTES
Use the class loadout rather than a new 60-point shopping budget. The class provides no special ammunition; use normal rounds unless the GM awards or approves other ammunition. Follow the weapon rules for dual-wielding modifiers.

The complete prebuilt class equipment is retained. Carrying-slot accounting and any beta exceptions should be agreed with the GM. No spare equipment points or bonus XP have been added.
